SELECT ppa.CSH_ATTCAHMENT_ID, ppa.PAYMENT_REQ_ID, ppa.project_attachment_category, ppa.document_name, ppa.description, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND ppa.csh_attcahment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) file_name, ( SELECT max( fat.last_update_date ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND faam.table_pk_value = ppa.csh_attcahment_id ) upload_date, ( SELECT max( su.description ) FROM sys_user su, fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND faam.table_pk_value = ppa.csh_attcahment_id AND su.user_id = fat.last_updated_by ) upload_person,
(select max(faa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where faam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' and faam.table_pk_value = ppa.csh_attcahment_id and faa.source_pk_value = faam.record_id) attachment_id FROM csh_payment_attachment ppa WHERE ppa.project_attachment_category = 'CON_PAYMENT' and ppa.payment_req_id= #{paymentReqId}

SELECT ppa.CSH_ATTCAHMENT_ID, ppa.PAYMENT_REQ_ID, ppa.project_attachment_category, ppa.document_name, ppa.description, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND ppa.csh_attcahment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) file_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.attachment_id ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND ppa.csh_attcahment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) attachment_id, ( SELECT max( fat.last_update_date ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND faam.table_pk_value = ppa.csh_attcahment_id ) upload_date, ( SELECT max( su.description ) FROM sys_user su, fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND faam.table_pk_value = ppa.csh_attcahment_id AND su.user_id = fat.last_updated_by ) upload_person FROM csh_payment_attachment ppa WHERE ppa.project_attachment_category = 'CON_PAYMENT' and ppa.payment_req_id= #{paymentReqId}

SELECT ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM prj_project_bp p, hls_bp_master m WHERE p.PROJECT_ID =h1.source_doc_id and p.bp_id=m.bp_id and p.bp_type='WARRANTOR' and m.bp_class='NP') = 0 THEN 'ORG' ELSE 'NP' END ) BP_TYPE, ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM csh_payment_req_hd p WHERE p.SOURCE_DOC_ID IN ( SELECT pp.project_id FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.ref_project_id = h1.ref_project_id )) = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) yes_no
FROM ( SELECT hd.source_doc_id, ( SELECT pp.ref_project_id FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id = hd.source_doc_id ) ref_project_id, ( SELECT pp.project_id FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id = ( SELECT pp.ref_project_id FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id = hd.source_doc_id )) project_id, hd.PAYMENT_REQ_ID FROM csh_payment_req_hd hd ) h1 WHERE h1.payment_req_id = ${paymentReqId}
